plan.notes: Official ASU major map (Interdisciplinary Arts and Performance, BA, plan ASIAPBA, campus ASU00). Term-by-term sequence as published. Credit ranges transcribed at the lower bound per convention; 'X or Y' alternatives use the first-listed option as the course code with choice=true. Gen-ed placeholders (no course code on the map) transcribed verbatim as choice slots. The official major map lists the following course(s) in more than one term: Complete 2 courses: Elective, Complete 2 courses: IAP Upper Division Elective, ENG 101 or ENG 102: First-Year Composition OR ENG 105: Advanced First-Year Composition OR ENG 107 or ENG 108: First-Year Composition, Elective, Scientific Thinking in Natural Sciences (SCIT), Term hours subtotal:, Upper Division Global and Civic Engagement Requirement: satisfied through completion of 6 credits of upper-division courses with a Global Communities, Societies and Individuals (GCSI) or Governance and Civic Engagement (CIVI) designation, in addition to the courses used to meet the university General Studies requirements; or completion of 3 credits from an ASU-approved Global Education program. Adjustment to upper-division and elective hours is required if a lower-division Global Education course is used.; allow_repeated_courses is set per the genuine-repeat rule.
